headline: Granted variances for storage buildings at 84/86 Rockingham Road and a two-lot subdivision at 1 Family Ridge Drive; tabled 6 Pearl Street contractor yard case.
summary: Granted four variance requests: storage buildings at 84/86 Rockingham Road, a two-lot subdivision at 1 Family Ridge Drive, a wholesale auto dealer at 84 West Broadway, and a shed at 58 Beaver Lake Ave. Tabled the 6 Pearl Street contractor yard case to September 3, 2026, and tabled the July 16, 2026 minutes.
decisions: Granted a variance for 3 storage buildings totaling 11,675 sq ft at 84/86 Rockingham Road, by a 5-0 vote.
Granted a variance to subdivide 1 Family Ridge Drive into two lots with less frontage and lot width than required, by a 5-0 vote.
Granted a variance to allow a wholesale auto dealer at 84 West Broadway, with conditions, by a 5-0 vote.
Granted a variance to allow a shed 18 inches from the side property line at 58 Beaver Lake Ave, by a 5-0 vote.
Tabled case 26-118 for the contractor yard and garage at 6 Pearl Street to September 3, 2026.

decision_evidence.quote: Ms. Morin made a motion on case 26-121 to grant a variance to the terms of Article VI, Section 165-32.4.B.20 of the Town of Derry Zoning Ordinance to allow the construction of 3 buildings totaling 11,675 sq ft of additional storage space. ... The application was GRANTED by a vote of 5-0.

Ms. Morin made a motion on case 26-122 to grant a variance to the terms of Article VI, Section 165-46.C.2 & 3 of the Town of Derry Zoning Ordinance to allow the subdivision of the property into 2 lots with both lots proposed to have less than the required frontage and lot width. ... The application was GRANTED by a vote of 5-0.

Ms. Morin made a motion on case 26-123 to grant a variance to the terms of Article VI, Section 165.34.B of the Town of Derry Zoning Ordinance to allow the operation of a wholesale auto dealer from the property. ... The application was GRANTED by a vote of 5-0.

Ms. Morin made a motion on case 26-124 to grant a variance to the terms of Article VI, Section 165.4 of the Town of Derry Zoning ordinance to allow the construction of a shed 18 inches from the side property line at its closest point when 15 feet is required. ... The application was GRANTED by a vote of 5-0.
Ms. Morin made a motion to table Case 26-118 to September 3, 2026. Seconded by Mr. Dragani. All in favor.
Mr. Tripp made a motion to table July 16, 2026, meeting minutes. Seconded by Mr. Donlon. All in favor, none opposed.
